summary: Village site still 418 to curl and headless Chrome; read via Let's Camp (the village's engine since April 2025), village newsletters and council agendas on Wayback (2024-25) and Travel Alberta (2026). Confirmed 23 back-in sites (1-22 + 16A, 20-50 ft), 30/50 A, water at all, sewer at 4-22/16A; showers, flush toilets, dump, Wi-Fi. Booking moved from Camp Reservations Canada to Let's Camp (max 30 nights). Rates C$45-50 for 2025 (2024 rates + approved $5). Season left as stored (approximate, consistent with the Oct 2025 report). Not waterfront kept; pin fine.
flags: PHONE: '' -> 403-572-3244 (Village of Carbon office; on Let's Camp, the April 2025 newsletter and the 2025 village site capture). WEBSITE: keep https://www.villageofcarbon.com/attractions/campgrounds/ - the 2025-11-01 capture of the village site still links to it; it only refuses bots (418).

BOOKING CHANNEL CHANGED: the old note's 'Camp Reservations Canada' is wrong since April 2025; the old campreservations.ca listing (carbon-main-campground-136) now 301s to campspot.com's home page. Sibling 9042 Village of Carbon East Campground & Cabins carries the same stale CRC wording; its Let's Camp page is https://letscamp.ca/camps/carbon-east-campground (live, max 30 nights).

FEES are arithmetic, not a posted sheet: 2024 rates from the Dec 2024 RFD plus the $5 per site the January 2025 newsletter says council approved. The 2023 page said GST is included (stale, not written). Tent sites T1-T6 C$27 (2024) are not RV sites.

SEASON/STATUS: stored derived 05-15/10-14 (May long weekend to Thanksgiving) left alone. The 2023 page said 'open from May Long Weekend until the Tuesday following the Thanksgiving Long Weekend' (stale for season). The 27 Oct 2025 council Public Works report: 'The water to the campgrounds was shut off on October 7th ... dump stations have been closed for the season. The gate to both the Main and East campgrounds will be closed and locked at the end of October and reopened in the spring of 2026.' A Feb 2026 campground-attendant job posting and Travel Alberta (2026-09-25, 'Spring, Summer, Fall') show it operating in 2026. Let's Camp status reads 'closed' now (off season).
SITE LENGTH: sites 3 and 16A are 20 ft (Let's Camp); the other 21 sites are 25-50 ft, so a 23-ft rig fits. No criteria problem.

WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront - kept): Let's Camp's site map draws Kneehills Creek along the row with sites 10-16A and the washroom (the map is rotated; that row is the loop's east side, ~51.4858,-113.1503). On Esri imagery the creek (~51.4858,-113.1497, well under 30 m wide) is 25-35 m east of that track behind a continuous treed strip, so no site has open ground to the water; 'creekside' is not earned.
PIN: stored 51.48577,-113.15151 is inside the loop; Let's Camp's point 51.48515,-113.15236 is ~90 m away. No move.
POLICY: campground policy 2021-06 was being revised (Jan 20 2025 council action list, 'Council accepts the policy with amendments'); its text was not found.

Winter camping: a 2022 village 'Winter-Camping-Map.pdf' and an old CRC 'carbon-winter-camping' listing exist; Let's Camp has no winter-camping camp (slug carbon-winter-camping returns nothing). Current winter camping unknown; season not changed.
